tasks.description: Independently verify the owner calendar check projection, published interval evidence and corrected journal anchor.
constraints: English independent Reviewer and QA. Local gates only. The controller owns staging and shared usage checkpoints.

Preserve owner isolation, immediate recommendation and older clients. A date requires a factual owner/plant watering and separately sourced interval, with pause and elapsed-access suppression. No schedule writes, invented interval, recurrence, first aid, 024 or StoreKit.
